title: Nike and Michigan State Announce Eight-Year Extension of Longtime Partnership
summary: Nike and Michigan State University are announcing an eight-year extension of their all-sports partnership, building on more than a quarter century of shared history in East Lansing and beyond.
body_markdown:
Nike and Michigan State University are announcing an eight-year extension of their all-sports partnership, building on more than a quarter century of shared history in East Lansing and beyond.


For the past 26 years, Nike and Michigan State, two iconic brands with distinctive logos recognized worldwide, have partnered in support of Spartan student-athletes. The new partnership extension continues that relationship through June 30, 2035.


Included in the extension are custom basketball and football alternate uniforms, Michigan State–specific basketball footwear, Nike Sport Research Lab access for Spartan student-athletes, and Michigan State recognition as a preferred Nike testing partner.


“Michigan State has long represented the best of college athletics, with a tradition built on excellence, leadership and an unwavering commitment to student-athletes,” says Ann Miller, EVP, Global Sports Marketing. “From the impact of legends like Coach Tom Izzo to the countless Spartan alumni making a difference around the world, this is a university that continues to shape the future through sport. Together, we’ll continue creating new opportunities for the next generation of Spartans to grow, compete and lead.”


**What they’re saying:**


**Dan Bartholomae, MSU Vice President and Director of Athletics:** “Michigan State and Nike are each recognized as leaders in our respective fields. In extending this partnership, we reaffirm our shared commitment to champion Spartan student-athletes in their quest for excellence, including a substantially increased level of support from Nike. We greatly appreciate Nike’s continued belief in the future of Spartan Athletics.”


**Tom Izzo, Men’s Basketball Coach:** “When Michigan State and Nike teamed up beginning in 2000, it was validation for our program. It showed that one of biggest sports brands believed in what we were building and where we were going. Since then, it’s been an incredible partnership, with Nike becoming part of our DNA.”


**Tom Izzo, Men’s Basketball Coach:** “The Swoosh is so much more than a stylish logo. It represents the hard work the people at Nike put in to be the very best. Their drive for continual improvement is the same motivation found in our championship teams. For more than a quarter century, they’ve listened to our feedback and allowed our student-athletes to be involved in the footwear- and apparel-improvement process. As a result, Spartans wear the very best every time they take the court.”
